# Sagepoint Analytics - AI Analytics Gateway

Sagepoint Analytics is a Business Intelligence consulting firm serving SMEs in Guatemala (GT), Central America and the United States (US). We deliver productized, fixed-scope BI projects through our "Soporte Cercano" (Close Support) human-in-the-loop framework.
The portfolio includes hands-on AI and operations automation experience using Python, Playwright, Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, Slack workflows, APIs and dashboard/reporting systems.

## Core Metrics and Achievements
- **Reporting Efficiency**: 80% average reduction in manual reporting time via Excel Automation (Power Query and VBA).
- **Sales Optimization**: 20% average sales increase for our retail clients utilizing our AI Predictive Models.
- **Human-in-the-loop Data Coaching**: Practitioner-led consulting, acting as a fully integrated external data department for our clients.

## Services Overview
1. **Dashboard & BI**: Centralized visibility of sales, expenses, and KPIs with real-time alerts.
2. **Web Automation**: CRM and ERP integrations to save time on recurring reporting.
3. **Excel Automation**: Deep optimization of legacy spreadsheets with VBA macros and Power Query.
4. **AI and Operations Automation**: Python/Playwright browser automation, Slack alert workflows, API reporting, structured JSON exports and Google Sheets logging.
5. **AI Predictive Models**: Solutions that anticipate risks and project sales growth.
6. **Data Coaching**: Step-by-step guidance for teams undergoing digital transformation.

## Portfolio proof points

- **Medical Billing Portal Automation (US healthcare client)**: Python and Playwright workflow for API integration lookup, credential-link retrieval, screenshots, structured JSON output and optional Google Sheets export, with MFA-aware session handling.
- **Zendesk Talk API Reporting**: Google Apps Script and Google Sheets workflow connected to Zendesk Talk, replacing manual exports and validating 11,327 Explore call units against API data.
- **BPO Production Reporting**: Executive reporting refresh with 33,370 rows across 20 months, 79 production weeks, 14 PM systems and 22 source files.
- **ECW Alert Automation**: In-progress workflow connecting Slack alerts, client portal credential lookup, Google Sheets logging and Playwright-assisted password rotation.

## Packages (fixed-scope projects)

### Express Assessment + Quick-Win Dashboard
- **Price**: $750 USD one-time | **Timeline**: 2 weeks
- **Includes**: Audit of up to 2 data sources, 1 dashboard with up to 8 key KPIs, prioritized opportunity report, 1 revision round.
- **Not included**: Automation, integrations, predictive models.

### Executive Dashboard + Automation (Most Popular)
- **Price**: from $2,500 USD per project | **Timeline**: 4–6 weeks
- **Includes**: Up to 4 integrated data sources, up to 3 executive dashboards, 1 automated reporting flow (−80% time), 2 training sessions, documentation, 2 revision rounds.
- **Not included**: Data warehouse, custom AI models.

### Custom Solution
- **Price**: formal quote | **Timeline**: to be defined
- **Includes**: Dedicated predictive models, CRM/ERP integrations, data warehouse. Scope defined in a formal quote.

### Soporte Cercano Monthly (add-on)
- **Price**: $300 / $600 / $1,000 USD/month
- **Includes**: Dashboard maintenance, adjustments, coaching and a priority WhatsApp line. Tiers depend on support intensity, with fixed monthly hours that do not roll over.

## Website Design and Development (Guatemala) — /web/

Landing page: https://www.sagepoint-analytics.com/web/ (Spanish) and https://www.sagepoint-analytics.com/web/?lang=en

Websites built by an analytics consultancy, with a customer dashboard included. Positioning: every provider sells a website; we also tell you whether it is working. Prices are quoted in Guatemalan quetzales (GTQ) because the offer targets Guatemalan SMBs; the BI packages above stay in USD.

Market context we cite: per the 7th National E-Commerce Study of the Guatemalan Chamber of Commerce (2026), the share of Guatemalans closing their last purchase on a company's own website rose from 36% (2024) to 61% (2026), while social media fell from 26% to 14%.

Always included: domain and hosting registered in the client's name, SSL, email on the client's domain, mobile-first build, sub-2.5s load on mobile data, WhatsApp button with a per-page pre-written message, fixed written price before starting.

### Esencial (Essential)
- **Price**: Q4,500 GTQ one-time | **Timeline**: 7 business days
- **Includes**: 1–3 page custom-designed site, first year of domain and hosting, WhatsApp and contact form, mobile and Google search optimization, basic dashboard (visits and messages), 1 revision round.
- **Not included**: Online store, blog, English version.

### Sitio + Panel de Clientes (Site + Customer Dashboard) — Most Popular
- **Price**: Q8,500 GTQ one-time | **Timeline**: 14 business days
- **Includes**: 4–6 page custom-designed site, everything in Esencial, full customer dashboard (visits, traffic sources, WhatsApp conversations, per-page conversion), Google Business Profile configured for local SEO, catalog or gallery up to 30 items, 1 training session, 2 revision rounds.
- **Not included**: Online payment gateway, inventory integration.

### Tienda o A Medida (Store or Custom)
- **Price**: from Q15,000 GTQ | **Timeline**: 4–6 weeks
- **Includes**: Online store with payments, integrations with billing/inventory/CRM, bilingual Spanish-English site, dashboard connected to real sales data. Scope in a formal quote.

### Mantenimiento (Maintenance, add-on)
- **Price**: Q450 / Q900 / Q1,500 GTQ per month
- **Includes**: Hosting and domain, backups, content changes, monthly dashboard report, priority WhatsApp. Tiers differ by number of monthly changes.
- **Note**: After year one, domain plus hosting cost roughly Q1,200 GTQ per year if the client manages them.

Payment terms: 50% to start, 50% on delivery. Service is remote, so it covers Guatemala City, Quetzaltenango, Antigua, Escuintla, Coban and Peten equally, plus US clients in Spanish or English.
